item.title: Trump vows Iran war to end "very quickly" as more troops head to Mideast
item.description: Some 9,000 more U.S. forces are headed for the Middle East as President Trump vows the war will end "right after the election," if not sooner.

item.title: G7 nations will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel to combat high prices
item.description: G7 countries have agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and fuel products, starting with diesel. Joe Brettell, founder and principal of Forward Energy, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Makers of "Atonement" discuss their new film about a Marine and the first Iraq War
item.description: A new film, "Atonement," is based on the true story of a U.S. Marine who served in the first Iraq War. In the early days of the war he mistakenly fired on a family driving through a chaotic Baghdad intersection. Shots were being fired in many directions, but the Marine gunfire killed three civilians. The movie chronicles the Marine's long-simmering guilt and trauma and an elongated effort to reach out to the surviving family members in an attempt to find some manner of reconciliation. Reed Van Dyk, the film's producer and director, Dexter Filkins, who wrote the New Yorker story the film's script is based off of, and Boyd Holbrook, who stars in the movie, join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: CBS News poll finds voters split on state v. national focus in Maine Senate race
item.description: Troy Jackson is boosted by those looking for change, while Collins peels off some Trump disapprovers.

item.title: U.K. police accuse 2 Iranian men of planning terror attack on Jewish community
item.description: Two Iranian men have been charged with plotting a terror attack on the Jewish community in Manchester, British police said.

item.title: More details emerge about FlyDubai co-pilot who tried to crash plane
item.description: Questions about the motive of the co-pilot who tried to crash a packed flight from Dubai to Israel continue to swirl.

item.title: What to know about the ALDS and NLDS
item.description: Baseball's postseason is into the League Divisional Series. Former New York Mets General Manager Steve Phillips joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: "Amazing Race" co-creator shares what to expect from hit show's new season
item.description: Elise Doganieri, co-creator and executive producer of "The Amazing Race," joins "The Daily Report" to share details about the show's new season. New episodes will air every Wednesday at 9:30 p.m. on CBS.

item.title: Stray Kids join BTS in Grammy Awards boycott over new "Best Asian Pop" category
item.description: K-Pop group Stray Kids is joining BTS in refusing to submit music for award consideration in the upcoming Grammys over a new "Best Asian Pop" category. SiriusXM Radio host Lamar Dawson joins CBS News to discuss that and some of the films, including "Diggers" and "Verity," hitting theaters.

item.title: Chinese AI model Qwen gives alarming answers to questions about Hong Kong, controversial topics
item.description: Qwen, a popular Chinese AI model, might have been programmed to give government-friendly answers to controversial questions, according to new research. CBS News' Josh Boswell has more.

item.title: Title IX expert explains reporting process amid Cornell rape investigation
item.description: Rachel Laubis, a Title IX adviser, joins "The Daily Report" to explain the sexual assault reporting process and what Cornell University's responsibilities were in the Jane Doe case.

item.title: U.S. jobs growth slows in September as unemployment climbs to 4.2%
item.description: The U.S. economy added 29,000 jobs in September, according to a new jobs report, far fewer than were added in August. CBS News business reporter Emily Pandise has more.

item.title: Extended interview: Ted Cruz on NIL legislation, Paxton-Talarico, Trump's approval rating and more
item.description: Sen. Ted Cruz speaks with Tony Dokoupil about the Protect College Sports Act, the upcoming midterm elections, the latest approval ratings for President Trump and more.

item.title: New bodycam footage shows moment Luigi Mangione was arrested at McDonald's
item.description: Newly released bodycam footage shows the arrest of Luigi Mangione, who has since pleaded guilty to murdering UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson. Ali Bauman has more.

item.title: Latest on investigation into alleged rape at Cornell as Letitia James appointed as prosecutor
item.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul on Friday appointed Letitia James as special prosecutor for the investigation into the alleged rape at a Cornell University frat house in 2024. CBS News' Lilia Luciano has more.

item.title: Senate GOP group pours millions into defending Kansas seat
item.description: The race for control of the Senate is changing in the final weeks before the midterms, with the GOP defending several traditionally red-leaning states.

item.title: FlyDubai pilot tells his survival story in emotional call with Indian leader
item.description: The FlyDubai captain attacked by his co-pilot tells his harrowing survival story to India's leader in an emotional video call from his hospital bed.

item.title: Details emerge in case of former Cornell student alleging rape by frat members
item.description: A woman, identified only as Jane Doe, alleges she was gang-raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 and accuses Cornell University of failing to protect her.

item.title: A valet became a key source of support for cancer patients at a N.Y. care center
item.description: Jon Avery, who parks cars at the Roswell Cancer Center in Buffalo, New York, says his goal when interacting with patients is to "have a meaningful encounter that's not hollow."

item.title: Newly released footage shows Luigi Mangione's arrest in Pennsylvania
item.description: Body camera video shows Altoona police arresting Luigi Mangione, questioning him about a fake ID and recovering evidence later linked to the fatal shooting of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.

item.title: 10/2: CBS Evening News
item.description: Cornell rape accuser's attorney speaks to CBS; New footage shows Luigi Mangione's arrest.

item.title: Feds charge shop clerk, son with selling illegal kratom after 2 Ole Miss deaths
item.description: Federal authorities investigating the deaths of two University of Mississippi students have charged a store clerk and his son with selling an illegal kratom product.

item.title: Gov. Hochul says N.Y. AG James will investigate Cornell gang rape allegation
item.description: Gov. Kathy Hochul has tapped New York Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor in the Cornell University alleged rape case.

item.title: 10/2: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: How Trump's foreign policy is impacting the midterms; U.S. job growth cools in last report before midterms.

item.title: Christa Pike critically ill, intubated after botched execution, attorneys say
item.description: Christa Pike "remains critically ill" and is receiving medical care after a botched execution attempt in Tennessee, her attorneys said.

item.title: Amazon vows to invest $1 billion in areas where it builds data centers
item.description: Amazon said it will invest $1 billion over five years to support job education, energy affordability and other priorities in communities where its data centers are located.

item.title: Photo of Jane Doe shared in Snapchat group on night of alleged rape
item.description: The photo was shared in a Snapchat group with dozens of Chi Phi fraternity brothers on the night the alleged victim says she was assaulted at Cornell.

item.title: Employers added 29,000 jobs in September, missing economic forecasts
item.description: Unemployment ticked up to 4.2% in September, while employers pulled back on hiring amid economic headwinds.

item.title: Transcript: Man accused in Cornell case allegedly asked student not to "say anything"
item.description: According to the record, a student who had been at the Chi Phi house the night of the alleged assault told a Title IX investigator she got a call the next day from one of the accused men.

item.title: Cornell Title IX investigation docs reveal new details on rape investigation
item.description: CBS News has examined hundreds of pages of transcripts from the Title IX investigation conducted by Cornell University into the allegations made by a former student who claims she was drugged and gang-raped at a fraternity house.
